CAREERS

Fulfill your career aspirations in an environment that brings out the best in you

Explore Infinite Opportunities with Healthium

We believe in celebrating exceptional people by providing a supportive work environment that fosters talent and encourages professional growth.

Here, you will have the chance to collaborate with innovative and forward-thinking leaders and work hand-in-hand with an accomplished team. With a focus on continuous learning, you will also have access to resources and opportunities that will propel you and your career forward.

Join us at Healthium and become part of a dynamic team that values exceptional talent and offers endless opportunities for career advancement!

#OneHealthium: The Healthium Way of Life

At Healthium, we have found strength in our diversity, imbued by our culture of mutual respect and empathy, as well as our adherence to the highest ethical standards – something we call #OneHealthium, the Healthium way of life.

Humility, integrity, passion and innovation together form the cornerstones of #OneHealthium and by extension, everything we create and value as an organisation. We take great pride in nurturing a team that exemplifies these ideologies, forming the core of our culture and steering us towards our vision.

Our consistent efforts have earned us the ‘Great Place to Work’ Certification for three years in a row.

A Multicultural, People-centric Workplace

Our people are our most valuable asset. Our diverse workforce is one of our biggest strengths and the rich experience they bring, across varied skill sets and backgrounds, is invaluable. Everyone at Healthium is bound together by our common values.

As a global player in precision medtech with a presence across 90+ countries and offices in India and the UK, Healthium offers a transparent and open office environment that celebrates the exchange of ideas and smooth workflow. That’s why we attribute our growth and success to our 3500 strong team, which has taken Healthium to greater heights every year.

What’s more, our emphasis on Diversity, Equity and Inclusion (DEI) has resulted in a fine pool of talent. Our employee-friendly policies, learning environment and respectful work ethic ensure that each individual feels valued, respected and inspired to excel. This, accompanied with a culture of rewards and recognition, ensures that a career at Healthium is immensely satisfying and truly rewarding.

Our Values

Living by our values of being Agile, Inquisitive, Collaborative and Accountable, our teams consistently strive to work towards our vision of providing ”access to precision medtech for every patient, globally.”

Inquisitive:

To nurture an eager desire to learn and seek new information and experiences that help achieve our vision

Agile:

To adapt to the rapidly changing global environment and explore opportunities that accelerate accessibility to our precision medtech solutions

Collaborative:

To work together with both internal and external stakeholders by securing their support and forming alliances that aid access to precision-based medtech solutions for our end users

Accountability:

To work together with both internal and external stakeholders by securing their support and forming alliances that aid access to precision-based medtech solutions for our end users

What’s in it for you?

  • The opportunity to work with inspirational, visionary leaders and great talent.
  • The opportunity to effect significant business impact across geographies and functions.
  • An exciting environment that empowers and enables you to perform your best.

Our Leadership

Led by a seasoned management team, Healthium has demonstrated its ability to develop and execute a focused strategy to grow our business, enabling us to strengthen our market position and deliver robust financial performance. This has been instrumental in enabling us to attract high-quality talent and work towards our long-term objective of delivering sustainable growth across our business and community.

Work With Us

We hire exceptionally talented individuals and ensure they are nurtured professionally. Our multi-dimensional work environment offers high growth trajectories through challenging roles with clear responsibilities, and the opportunity to work and learn through a variety of assignments. We provide full training, development, and career guidance programmes, and empower every member of our team to excel.

If you’re interested in exploring a rewarding career with Healthium, please send your CV to careers@healthiummedtech.com or apply for available roles below.

Open Positions

Healthium is an equal opportunity provider.
Manager - SCM | Stores | 14+ Years | Peenya, Bengaluru

Roles & Responsibilities

  • Accountable for managing end-to-end warehouse operations, inventory control and store efficiency
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams including Planning, Quality and Production to ensure seamless material flow and service levels
  • Monitor inventory accuracy, stock reconciliation and variance analysis while ensuring FIFO/FEFO compliance
  • Ensure timely issuance of raw and packaging materials to support uninterrupted production
  • Oversee storage, packing and dispatch of finished goods in line with quality and customer requirements
  • Plan and execute cycle counts and physical inventory audits, ensuring corrective and preventive actions
  • Optimize inbound and outbound logistics processes with accurate system updates and documentation
  • Drive productivity improvements through process optimization, layout enhancement and automation initiatives
  • Manage warehouse manpower, including shift planning, workload allocation and performance monitoring
  • Improve labor productivity through KPI tracking, workforce optimization and cost control
  • Implement 6S practices to enhance safety, efficiency and housekeeping standards
  • Ensure adherence to SOPs, EHS policies and compliance requirements across operations
  • Identify cost-saving opportunities in warehousing and transportation through optimization initiatives
  • Drive continuous improvement in service levels, operational efficiency and overall warehouse performance

Qualifications

  • Graduation / MBA with 14+ years of experience in warehouse management, inventory control or supply chain operations

Product Specialists - Domestic Sales | Endosurgery | 5+ Years | Surat/Ahmedabad

Roles & Responsibilities

  • Accountable for driving sales growth and market development within the assigned Endosurgery territory
  • Develop and execute territory sales strategies to generate new revenue opportunities and expand existing accounts
  • Build and maintain strong customer relationships through a consultative, solutions-oriented approach
  • Conduct product presentations and demonstrations to drive awareness and adoption of solutions
  • Identify, engage and convert potential customers by understanding clinical and business needs
  • Maintain a strong pipeline of opportunities to consistently meet revenue targets
  • Lead negotiations and close high-value deals to strengthen market presence
  • Monitor and manage relationships with existing customers to ensure repeat business and satisfaction
  • Collaborate with internal teams to develop proposals and support deal execution
  • Track market trends, competitor activities and identify growth opportunities
  • Ensure accurate and timely reporting of sales activities, forecasts and pipeline
  • Coordinate with cross-functional teams to ensure seamless execution and customer success

Qualifications

  • Graduation in Science with minimum 5 years of experience in sales, business development or Endosurgery/medical devices industry

Manager - Strategy & Operations | International Business | 4+ Years | Hebbal, Bengaluru

Roles & Responsibilities

  • Accountable for driving strategy execution and operational excellence across international markets
  • Drive governance forums, structured reviews and leadership updates
  • Execute growth strategies across markets including expansion and distributor performance
  • Establish dashboards and KPIs to track performance and profitability
  • Lead product registration, launch readiness and rollout across global markets
  • Track launch performance and drive post-launch optimization
  • Provide insights on sales, pricing, margins and inventory for planning
  • Identify operational gaps and drive process improvements
  • Oversee pricing, contracts, sales support and customer experience
  • Coordinate with supply chain and manufacturing for order execution
  • Support forecasting, planning and inventory availability
  • Ensure audit readiness and manage global commercial agreements

Qualifications

  • MBA with 4+ years of experience in strategy, operations or international business

Production Executive - Manufacturing | Production | 3+ Years | Sri City

Roles & Responsibilities

  • Accountable for executing production operations as per quality standards
  • Ensure hygiene and compliance across production areas
  • Execute production plans and monitor work-in-progress
  • Manage manpower allocation and productivity
  • Oversee sterilization (ETO) processes
  • Verify raw materials as per batch records
  • Monitor processes and resolve production issues
  • Maintain ISO and QMS documentation
  • Reduce rejection rates and improve efficiency
  • Conduct operator training and performance checks
  • Ensure adherence to EHS policies

Qualifications

  • Graduation in Engineering / Science / Pharmacy with 3+ years of experience

Senior Executive - Manufacturing | Engineering | 3+ Years | Noida

Roles & Responsibilities

  • Accountable for CNC programming and machining optimization
  • Review CAD models and define machining strategies
  • Develop and optimize CNC programs
  • Prepare setup sheets and machining instructions
  • Select tools, fixtures and raw materials
  • Guide operators during setups and machining
  • Monitor processes and ensure quality compliance
  • Troubleshoot programming and machine issues
  • Maintain documentation and production records
  • Support new product development activities
  • Ensure adherence to safety standards

Qualifications

  • Diploma / B.E. / B.Tech in Mechanical Engineering with 3+ years of experience

Assistant Manager - Quality Assurance | Customer Complaints & SQM | 5+ Years | Ahmedabad

Roles & Responsibilities

  • Accountable for managing customer complaints and supplier quality systems
  • Handle end-to-end customer complaint lifecycle
  • Maintain complaint database and perform trend analysis
  • Coordinate investigations with internal teams and labs
  • Manage supplier onboarding and quality audits
  • Maintain supplier documentation and audit records
  • Act as audit POC for complaints and SQM activities
  • Ensure compliance with QMS procedures
  • Collaborate with teams for timely issue resolution

Qualifications

  • Graduate/Postgraduate in Engineering/Science with 5+ years of experience

Executive - Quality Assurance | FG | 3+ Years | Peenya, Bengaluru

Roles & Responsibilities

  • Accountable for finished goods and import material release
  • Perform incoming inspection and verificatio
  • Review documentation including COA and compliance records
  • Prepare inspection reports and certificates
  • Ensure labeling and packaging compliance
  • Coordinate with QA, RA and warehouse teams
  • Maintain traceability and documentation
  • Handle non-conformances and corrective actions
  • Ensure SAP-based material release

Qualifications

  • Diploma in Engineering with 3+ years of experience

Officer - Quality Assurance | 1+ Years | Peenya, Bengaluru

Roles & Responsibilities

  • Accountable for QMS compliance and quality processes
  • Ensure adherence to ISO, MDR and FDA standards
  • Manage QMS documentation and audits
  • Track KPIs and drive quality improvements
  • Handle complaints, investigations and CAPA
  • Support regulatory audits and compliance
  • Conduct risk assessments and quality reviews
  • Train teams on quality standards
  • Support validation and qualification activities

Qualifications

  • Graduate/Postgraduate in Engineering/Science with 10+ years of experience

Biomedical Engineer - Sironix | Biomedical | 1+ Year | Bengaluru, Pune

Roles & Responsibilities

  • Accountable for installation and service of arthroscopy equipment
  • Install and commission equipment at customer sites
  • Provide OT support during surgeries and demos
  • Conduct preventive maintenance and troubleshooting
  • Maintain service logs and ensure uptime
  • Build relationships with hospital biomedical teams
  • Support product trials and demonstrations
  • Coordinate with internal teams for service support
  • Ensure compliance with quality standards

Qualifications

  • B.E / B.Tech / Diploma in Biomedical/Electronics with 1+ year of experience

Executive - NPD | 4–8 Years | Peenya, Bengaluru

Roles & Responsibilities

  • Accountable for product design and development activities
  • Design and document new products
  • Plan and execute design verification testing
  • Conduct risk analysis and mitigation planning
  • Collaborate with QA, RA and production teams
  • Coordinate testing with internal and external labs
  • Manage project trackers and vendor coordination
  • Maintain design documentation and reports
  • Support product lifecycle from concept to launch

Qualifications

  • Biomedical / Mechanical Engineering with 4 to 8 years of experience

Area Manager - Sironix | Sales | 8–10 Years | Chennai, Mumbai, Kolkata

Roles & Responsibilities

  • Accountable for achieving sales targets and market expansion
  • Develop relationships with doctors and institutions
  • Conduct product presentations and demonstrations
  • Maintain engagement with channel partners
  • Execute product promotion activities
  • Manage sales reporting and administration
  • Identify new business opportunities
  • Track competitor activity and market trend
  • Monitor performance and align to targets

Qualifications

  • Graduation in Science with 8 to 10 years of experience

Deputy Manager - Clinical Affairs & Regulatory | 9–10 Years | Hebbal, Bengaluru

Roles & Responsibilities

  • Accountable for regulatory compliance across markets
  • Manage product registrations and approvals globally
  • Support regulatory documentation and certifications
  • Ensure compliance with EU MDR, USFDA and other standards
  • Coordinate audits and corrective actions
  • Handle 510(k), PMA and regulatory submissions
  • Maintain certifications and approvals
  • Collaborate with stakeholders for compliance activities
  • Support regulatory strategy for new products

Qualifications

  • M.Pharm / B.Pharm / MSc with 9–10 years of experience in regulatory affairs

Marketing Specialist - Domestic Sales | Hernia | 5–8 Years | Ahmedabad

Roles & Responsibilities

  • Accountable for driving clinical adoption and market development of the Hernia portfolio through structured engagement and field-driven insights.
  • Identify and manage key sites for New Product Development (NPD) evaluations, coordinating with sales and medical teams for effective execution.
  • Ensure active presence in operating theatres to capture procedural insights, feedback and opportunities for product improvement.
  • Track evaluation-to-adoption ratios and share field intelligence to support product positioning and refinement.
  • Build and strengthen relationships with Key Opinion Leaders (KOLs) and Key Business Leaders (KBLs) to drive product advocacy and adoption.
  • Plan and execute clinical engagement initiatives including Nurses Training Programs (NTPs) and Round Table Meetings (RTMs).
  • Collaborate with medical affairs and KOLs to design clinically relevant content for workshops and training programs.
  • Lead capability-building initiatives by training sales and clinical teams on product features, procedures and competitive differentiation.
  • Organize and facilitate Regional Advisory Boards to gather insights on surgical trends, unmet needs and product performance.
  • Plan and execute marketing engagement programs such as STEPs and other clinical initiatives to expand procedural adoption.
  • Evaluate effectiveness of marketing initiatives based on conversions, engagement and return on investment.
  • Collaborate with trade and tender teams to support institutional business through clinical inputs and marketing strategies.
  • Act as a regional marketing interface, aligning cross-functional teams to support business objectives.

Qualifications

  • Graduation in Science with 5 to 8 years of experience in marketing, clinical engagement or medical devices.
Deputy Manager - Manufacturing | EHS | 6–8 Years | Sri City

Roles & Responsibilities

  • Accountable for developing and implementing Environment, Health and Safety (EHS) programs across the site.
  • Develop, implement and maintain EHS policies, procedures and compliance frameworks.
  • Ensure adherence to regulatory requirements and industry standards.
  • Conduct audits, inspections and risk assessments to identify and mitigate hazards.
  • Investigate incidents and implement corrective and preventive actions.
  • Lead EHS training programs to promote awareness and safe practices.
  • Develop and maintain emergency response plans and conduct drills.
  • Drive sustainability initiatives to reduce environmental impact.
  • Track and report EHS performance metrics and compliance status.
  • Collaborate with internal teams and external stakeholders to strengthen EHS culture.

Qualifications

  • Diploma / Advanced Diploma in Industrial Safety or related field with 6 to 8 years of EHS experience in manufacturing.
Production Officer - Executive | Manufacturing | Production | 3–5 Years | Coimbatore

Roles & Responsibilities

  • Accountable for executing production activities in line with quality and efficiency standards.
  • Ensure adherence to hygiene and quality guidelines in production areas.
  • Execute production plans and monitor work-in-progress across stages.
  • Manage manpower allocation and productivity to meet production targets.
  • Monitor production processes and resolve issues to ensure smooth operations.
  • Maintain documentation in compliance with ISO and QMS requirements.
  • Drive reduction in rejection rates and improve process efficiency.
  • Conduct training for production staff and assess effectiveness.
  • Ensure adherence to EHS policies and safety standards.

Qualifications

  • Graduation in Engineering / Science / Pharmacy with 3 to 5 years of production experience.
Tender Business Manager - Domestic Sales | Tender | Min 5 years | Ahmedabad

Roles & Responsibilities

  • Identify potential business opportunities by analyzing tender documents and coordinating with internal stakeholders for participation.
  • Navigate rate contracts with medical colleges and ensure alignment with institutional requirements.
  • Develop strong understanding of the government hospital business to drive sales and market penetration.
  • Possess working knowledge of procurement processes, including Government e-Marketplace (GeM).
  • Demonstrate detailed expertise in the tender bidding process, ensuring timely and compliant submissions.
  • Maintain regular and frequent contact with channel partners to build strong business relationships.
  • Ensure all tender submissions comply with applicable legal, regulatory and organizational standards.
  • Develop competitive pricing models through cost analysis and market condition evaluation.
  • Generate regular reports on sales activities, tender performance and market trends.
  • Share competitive intelligence and field activities with management to support business and product planning.
  • Review personal sales performance against objectives, adjusting strategies and activities as needed to achieve sales targets.
  • Implement territory coverage plans defining customer support levels and frequency of contact and recommend plan adjustments where required.

Qualifications

  • Graduation in Science (mandatory).
  • Minimum 5 years of experience in government sales, specifically in tendering.
Manager – Production | 8–10 Years | Sri City

Roles & Responsibilities

  • Manage production planning and on-time delivery.
  • Ensure effective utilization of manpower, machines and materials.
  • Support ERP activities and production documentation.
  • Participate in audits, validations and compliance activities.
  • Coordinate with planning, supply chain and maintenance teams.
  • Monitor productivity, yield and rejection trends.
  • Drive CAPA, customer complaint resolution and quality improvements.
  • Support new product introduction and process improvements.
  • Ensure safety, quality and regulatory compliance.

Qualifications

  • Graduation in Engineering or Bachelor of Science.
  • 8–10 years of experience in Medical Device or Pharmaceutical Manufacturing.
Associate Area Manager – Key Accounts (Corporate) | 3+ Years | Bengaluru, Kolkata, Mumbai

Roles & Responsibilities

  • Achieve sales targets through customer acquisition, account development and expansion within existing corporate accounts.
  • Build and maintain strong relationships with doctors, hospitals, channel partners and key stakeholders.
  • Schedule and conduct regular customer meetings to strengthen engagement and identify business opportunities.
  • Promote and demonstrate the company’s surgical product portfolio to healthcare professionals and institutional customers.
  • Develop business within existing accounts while identifying opportunities to introduce new products and solutions.
  • Prepare and deliver product presentations to support customer awareness and product adoption.
  • Negotiate commercial terms, prepare quotations and support order closures to achieve sales objectives.
  • Maintain regular interactions with channel partners to ensure business growth and service excellence.
  • Coordinate with internal teams to provide timely support and ensure customer satisfaction.
  • Execute product promotion activities and support marketing initiatives within the assigned territory.
  • Monitor market trends, customer feedback and competitive activities to support business planning and strategy.
  • Maintain accurate records of sales activities, customer interactions, expenses and claims through company systems and mobile applications.
  • Review sales performance against targets and implement corrective actions to achieve business objectives.
  • Execute territory coverage plans to ensure effective customer engagement and optimal market coverage.

Qualifications

  • Science graduate.
  • 3+ years of experience in Medical Device, Healthcare or Surgical Product Sales.
Executive – Clinical Affairs & Regulatory (Materiovigilance) | 2+ Years | Hebbal, Bengaluru

Roles & Responsibilities

  • Accountable for driving strategy execution and operational excellence across international markets
  • Act as a central connector between international markets and cross-functional teams
  • Drive governance forums, structured reviews and leadership updates
  • Execute growth strategies across markets including expansion and distributor performance
  • Establish dashboards and KPIs to track performance and profitability
  • Lead product registration, launch readiness and rollout across global markets
  • Track launch performance and drive post-launch optimization
  • Provide insights on sales, pricing, margins and inventory for planning
  • Identify operational gaps and drive process improvements
  • Oversee pricing, contracts, sales support and customer experience
  • Coordinate with supply chain and manufacturing for order execution
  • Support forecasting, planning and inventory availability
  • Ensure audit readiness and manage global commercial agreements

Qualifications

  • B.Pharm or M.Pharm.
  • 2+ years of experience in Clinical Affairs, Regulatory Affairs, Materiovigilance or Post Market Surveillance.
Manager - Plant Finance | Plant Finance | 7-10 Years | Bengaluru/Sri City

Roles & Responsibilities

  • Analyze manufacturing costs, COGS and operational variances.
  • Monitor material, overhead and purchase price variances.
  • Provide insights on capacity utilization, yield and operational performance.
  • Drive cost optimization across manufacturing, logistics and procurement.
  • Monitor inventory accuracy, aging, provisioning and stock health.
  • Conduct inventory reviews and support working capital optimization.
  • Reduce excess inventory, obsolescence and inventory write-offs.
  • Support budgeting, forecasting, MIS reporting and management reviews.
  • Ensure compliance with inventory controls and financial processes.
  • Support internal and external audits related to inventory and operations.
  • Monitor key financial and supply chain KPIs.
  • Drive continuous improvement in plant finance and operational efficiency.

Qualifications

  • CMA qualification is mandatory.
  • 7–10 years of experience in Plant Finance, Manufacturing Finance or Supply Chain Finance.
Assistant Manager – Talent Acquisition | 8+ Years | Hebbal, Bengaluru

Roles & Responsibilities

  • Drive recruitment strategies aligned with business requirements.
  • Manage end-to-end hiring across assigned business functions.
  • Build talent pipelines through multiple sourcing channels.
  • Partner with hiring managers to deliver timely closures.
  • Manage recruitment vendors and ensure SLA compliance.
  • Track hiring metrics and recruitment performance.
  • Handle background verification and pre-joining formalities.
  • Manage recruitment documentation, reports and stakeholder updates.
  • Support payroll inputs, vendor payments and recruitment operations.
  • Mentor recruiters and drive hiring process improvements.

Qualifications

  • Any Graduation / MBA.
  • Minimum 8 years of experience in Talent Acquisition.
MSO – International Business | 2–8 Years | Hebbal, Bengaluru

Roles & Responsibilities

  • Support customer documentation and sales requirements.
  • Prepare quotations and product coding with sales teams.
  • Generate proforma invoices and sales documents.
  • Coordinate product samples for customer and tender requirements.
  • Prepare MIS reports and business data analysis.
  • Support international business operations and coordination.

Qualifications

  • 2–8 years of relevant experience.
  • SAP knowledge and advanced Excel skills are preferred.
Product Manager – Endo | 5+ Years | Hebbal, Bengaluru

Roles & Responsibilities

  • Develop and execute growth strategies for Endo products.
  • Drive business development and revenue generation.
  • Manage customer relationships and key accounts.
  • Identify new market opportunities and partnerships.
  • Lead product positioning and sales support activities.
  • Monitor sales pipeline, forecasts and business performance.
  • Collaborate with internal teams for customer solutions.
  • Support product launches and market expansion initiatives.

Qualifications

  • 5+ years of experience in product management or medical device sales.
  • Experience in Endo Surgery products is preferred.
Cluster Lead – International Business | 3–5+ Years | Hebbal, Bengaluru

Roles & Responsibilities

  • Develop sales strategies for assigned international markets.
  • Manage distributors, agents and key accounts.
  • Build relationships with customers and healthcare stakeholders.
  • Analyze market trends and identify growth opportunities.
  • Support regulatory and market access requirements.
  • Coordinate with internal teams for market development.
  • Represent the company at industry events and exhibitions.
  • Manage sales forecasts and business reports.

Qualifications

  • MBA in Operations or International Business preferred.
  • 3–5+ years of international business experience.
Process Engineering | 5–8 Years | Peenya, Bengaluru

Roles & Responsibilities

  • Optimize manufacturing processes to improve productivity and quality.
  • Drive Lean, Operational Excellence and continuous improvement initiatives.
  • Conduct process studies, capacity analysis and line balancing.
  • Lead process validation and engineering compliance activities.
  • Support new product introduction and technology transfer projects.
  • Improve equipment utilization and automation initiatives.
  • Monitor process KPIs and drive corrective actions.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams for process improvements.
  • Ensure compliance with quality, safety and regulatory requirements.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Engineering.
  • 5–8 years of experience in Process Engineering.
Executive – Production | 2–4 Years | Ahmedabad

Roles & Responsibilities

  • Execute daily production activities as per schedules.
  • Supervise manufacturing operations and team activities.
  • Monitor productivity, quality and process compliance.
  • Support process improvements and yield enhancement initiatives.
  • Ensure compliance with GMP, ISO and regulatory requirements.
  • Maintain production documentation and records.
  • Coordinate with quality, maintenance and support teams.
  • Support continuous improvement and operational excellence initiatives.

Qualifications

  • Diploma or Degree in Engineering (Mechanical preferred).
  • 2–4 years of experience in the Medical Device Industry.
Officer – Packing (Manufacturing) | 1–1.5 Years | Kunigal

Roles & Responsibilities

  • Execute production and packing plans as per schedules.
  • Receive, verify and issue RM/PM materials for production requirements.
  • Maintain departmental inventory and stock accuracy.
  • Ensure daily production and packing targets are achieved.
  • Monitor rejections and implement corrective actions.
  • Allocate and monitor manpower based on operational requirements.
  • Train operators and maintain process adherence.
  • Ensure proper labeling, storage and handling of products.
  • Maintain BMR, QMS and production documentation.
  • Support IQA, CAPA, complaint handling and process improvements.
  • Ensure workplace safety, hygiene and compliance standards.

Qualifications

  • Graduation in Science or Arts.
  • 1–1.5 years of manufacturing experience.
  • Experience in Packing Operations is preferred.
Executive – Maintenance | 3+ Years | Noida

Roles & Responsibilities

  • Perform preventive and breakdown maintenance activities.
  • Ensure smooth functioning of plant equipment and utilities.
  • Support equipment installation, qualification and commissioning.
  • Monitor machine performance and reduce downtime.
  • Coordinate with production teams for maintenance planning.
  • Maintain maintenance records and documentation.
  • Ensure compliance with safety and maintenance procedures.
  • Support continuous improvement initiatives.

Qualifications

  • Diploma or Degree in Engineering.
  • 3+ years of maintenance experience in Manufacturing Environments.
Project Manager – NPD | 5–8 Years | Peenya, Bengaluru

Roles & Responsibilities

  • Lead new product development projects from concept to commercialization.
  • Develop project plans, schedules and milestones.
  • Coordinate cross-functional teams and stakeholders.
  • Monitor project timelines, risks and deliverables.
  • Drive stage-gate reviews and project governance activities.
  • Support regulatory, quality and compliance requirements.
  • Manage vendors, development partners and suppliers.
  • Monitor project budgets, reports and performance metrics.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Engineering or related field.
  • 5–8 years of Project Management experience.
Executive – Quality Control (Microbiology) | 5+ Years | Peenya, Bengaluru

Roles & Responsibilities

  • Perform microbiological testing and environmental monitoring activities.
  • Prepare culture media and maintain laboratory equipment.
  • Conduct sterility, bioburden and antimicrobial efficacy testing.
  • Perform product, environmental and sample analysis as per schedules.
  • Monitor cleanroom conditions and ensure compliance requirements.
  • Maintain laboratory records, reports and documentation.
  • Prepare biological and chemical indicators.
  • Support validation activities including ETO and Gamma sterilization.
  • Conduct calibration, swab testing and culture handling activities.
  • Support SOP revisions, trend analysis and quality improvement initiatives.
  • Ensure compliance with laboratory safety and quality standards.

Qualifications

  • Postgraduate or Graduate in Science or Engineering.
  • 5+ years of experience in QC or Production.
Manager – Strategic Sourcing | 12–15 Years | Peenya, Bengaluru

Roles & Responsibilities

  • Develop and implement strategic sourcing initiatives.
  • Identify, evaluate and develop supplier capabilities.
  • Build long-term partnerships with key suppliers.
  • Analyze market trends and mitigate supply risks.
  • Drive supplier performance across quality, cost and delivery.
  • Support alternate sourcing and vendor development initiatives.
  • Collaborate with planning and business teams to meet demand requirements.
  • Manage sourcing budgets and procurement strategies.
  • Support new product sourcing and supplier transition activities.
  • Drive continuous improvement in sourcing and supplier management.

Qualifications

  • Any Graduation / MBA.
  • 12–15 years of experience in Strategic Sourcing or Procurement.
Product Marketing - Sironix | 5–8 Years | Hebbal, Bengaluru

Roles & Responsibilities

  • Build relationships with key opinion leaders and orthopaedic surgeons.
  • Support clinical engagement activities, CMEs and conferences.
  • Conduct cadaveric workshops, training programs and first-case support.
  • Develop sales enablement tools and product training materials.
  • Deliver product and procedural training to field teams.
  • Support surgeon adoption and reference-building initiatives.
  • Develop marketing campaigns and product positioning strategies.
  • Monitor market trends and competitive activities.
  • Collaborate with sales teams to drive business growth.

Qualifications

  • B.Sc., B.Pharm or Engineering degree.
  • MBA preferred.
  • 5–8 years of Medical Device/s marketing experience.

If you’re interested in any of the above roles, send your CV to careers@healthiummedtech.com.
